name: invinoveritas — Verification Layer for Autonomous Agents
description: A NEUTRAL, model-agnostic verification provider for the agent economy — the independent validator/trusted-judge the ERC-8004 Validation Registry is designed to route to. /review returns a capital-scale-aware verdict BEFORE an irreversible action (the same gate we run our own important decisions through); /prove returns a portable schnorr-signed proof; /ledger is a public, Nostr- and Bitcoin-anchored, on-chain-outcome-linked track record you verify against our published key WITHOUT trusting us — the ERC-8004 Reputation feed as reputation you RECOMPUTE from settled outcomes (wins AND losses), not a mutable score a scorer controls. The one thing an agent can't self-serve is trust in another agent's output. Pay per call in Lightning, USDC (x402 on Base), or card. Pricing (USDC, per call): review() https://api.babyblueviper.com/review @ ~$0.16; verify-proof() https://api.babyblueviper.com/verify-proof @ free; payment-receipt() https://api.babyblueviper.com/payment-receipt @ free; prove() @ ~$0.12. Or subscribe to ongoing governance (monthly, by card) for a money-touching agent: plans at https://api.babyblueviper.com/billing/plans.
verify: POST /verify-proof with a signed verdict event, or NIP-01 against verifierPubkey.
